title: Orchard Commons allocation
scenario: V10 and I04 • Compare allocations with three owned minimums and retain the decision through later edits.
fixture: 12 plots; minimum gardens/grove/play 6/5/4; three fixed branch seeds.

slides.caption: Open a fresh session
slides.expected: Compare three 12-plot branches against the three owners' minimums.

slides.caption: Relax Fern's minimum to five
slides.expected: Plot counts stay fixed. Fern's shortfall in Commons falls to one.

slides.caption: Raise shared supply to 13
slides.expected: Every branch gains one garden. Commons meets Fern and Pip's requests.

slides.caption: Transfer a Commons play plot to grove
slides.action: Transfer a Commons play plot to grove
slides.expected: Only Commons changes. Ash gains a grove plot and Pip loses a play plot.

slides.caption: Select Commons, enter a reason and promote
slides.action: Select Commons, enter a reason and promote
slides.expected: The decision records five gardens, five grove and three play plots. Pip remains one short.

slides.caption: Restore the Commons play plot
slides.expected: Pip's current request is met. The promoted allocation retains the earlier shortfall and reason.

slides.caption: Undo promotion
slides.expected: The decision clears while the edited working branches and owned minimums remain.
